name: fallback_rm_contact
label: Fallback RM Contact
help_text: The contact whose details are shown when the logged-in member has no Relationship Manager associated. Defaults to the Client Success Team contact — edit that record in HubSpot to update the fallback display, or pick a different contact here to override per-page.

name: association_type_id
label: Association Type ID
help_text: USER_DEFINED association type ID for the contact-to-contact 'contact owner' relationship. Find it in HubSpot Settings → Objects → Contacts → Associations. When set, the card auto-populates from the associated contact. The entire section is hidden if no associated contact is found.

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
help_text: Controls the HTML heading tag for the section heading. Use H2 for a standard section within a page.

name: section_heading
label: Section Heading
help_text: Heading displayed above the RM contact card.

name: section_subtitle
label: Section Subtitle
help_text: Subtitle text displayed below the section heading.
default: Talk to them for personalised financial solution

name: rm_booking_link
label: Booking Link
help_text: URL for the RM's booking/meeting page (e.g. Calendly or HubSpot Meetings). Leave empty to hide the link.

name: rm_booking_link_text
label: Booking Link Text
help_text: Clickable text displayed for the booking link.

name: phone_icon
label: Phone Icon
help_text: Icon shown next to phone number. Upload SVG/PNG from Files Manager OR paste raw SVG code. Leave both empty to use the built-in fallback icon.
